# Responsible E-Waste Platform — Operations & Observability Workbook
**System Version:** Sprint 4 Release Baseline | **Governance Reference:** Release Security Gate Policy & Administrator Observability Architecture | **Task:** Build Azure Monitor workbook, dead-letter & lag alerts, and release evidence links

This workbook provides live operational telemetry, Kafka consumption lag tracking, dead-letter investigation, and release evidence governance across containerized microservices in Azure Container Apps.

parameters.name: TimeRange
parameters.description: Select time range for telemetry signals

parameters.name: CorrelationId
parameters.description: Filter by business Correlation ID or Batch ID

content.json:
### Platform Readiness & Absence Check (Container Availability and Telemetry Freshness)
Monitors `/readyz` probe signals across Go API and Python Analytics Worker. Note: **Absence of telemetry is not evidence of health.** If a service has not reported in 5 minutes, it is marked as `TelemetryAbsent`.

content.query:
let AppPrefix = strcat("aca-ewaste-", "{Environment}", "-");
let Signals = union isfuzzy=true
    (ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | project TimeGenerated, App=tostring(ContainerAppName_s), Message=tostring(Log_s)),
    (ContainerAppConsoleLogs | project TimeGenerated, App=tostring(ContainerAppName), Message=tostring(Log))
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and App startswith AppPrefix
| extend j=parse_json(Message)
| where toint(j.telemetry_version)==1
| extend Observation=tostring(j.observation), Outcome=tostring(j.outcome), Code=tostring(j.code);
let ExpectedApps = datatable(AppSuffix:string) ["api","analytics"]
| extend App=strcat(AppPrefix,AppSuffix);
let Latest = Signals | summarize LastSignal=max(TimeGenerated) by App;
let Readiness = Signals | where Observation=="readiness"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) by App
| project App, LastReadiness=TimeGenerated, ReadinessOutcome=Outcome, ReadinessCode=Code;
ExpectedApps
| join kind=leftouter Latest on App
| join kind=leftouter Readiness on App
| project App, LastSignal, LastReadiness, ReadinessOutcome, ReadinessCode,
          TelemetryAbsent=isnull(LastSignal) or LastSignal<ago(5m),
          ReadinessUnknown=isnull(LastReadiness) or LastReadiness<ago(5m)

content.json:
### Stage Latency Percentiles & SLO Targets (HTTP Command and Async Worker Execution Durations)
Evaluates platform stage durations against Sprint 3 / 4 SLO thresholds:
- **API Command Ingress (HTTP):** P95 <= 3,000 ms
- **Worker Async Analytics Step:** P95 <= 10,000 ms

content.query:
let AppPrefix = strcat("aca-ewaste-", "{Environment}", "-");
let Signals = union isfuzzy=true
    (ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | project TimeGenerated, App=tostring(ContainerAppName_s), Message=tostring(Log_s)),
    (ContainerAppConsoleLogs | project TimeGenerated, App=tostring(ContainerAppName), Message=tostring(Log))
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and App startswith AppPrefix
| extend j=parse_json(Message)
| where toint(j.telemetry_version)==1
| extend Observation=tostring(j.observation), Outcome=tostring(j.outcome), Code=tostring(j.code),
         Operation=tostring(j.operation), DurationMs=todouble(j.duration_ms);
Signals
| where Observation in ("http_request","outbox_published","processing_step")
| where isnotnull(DurationMs)
| summarize Samples=count(),
            P50Ms=round(percentile(DurationMs,50), 2),
            P95Ms=round(percentile(DurationMs,95), 2),
            P99Ms=round(percentile(DurationMs,99), 2)
            by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), App, Observation, Operation, Outcome
| extend SLO_Threshold_Ms = iff(App has "api", 3000.0, 10000.0)
| extend SLO_Status = iff(P95Ms > SLO_Threshold_Ms, "BREACHED", "COMPLIANT")
| order by TimeGenerated desc

content.json:
### Dead-Lettered Events & Quarantined Batches (Dead-Letter Alerting & Administrator Quarantine Triage)
Identifies batches and events that entered `QUARANTINED` or `REJECTED` status, or experienced persistent worker failure streaks. Quarantined records require operator remediation prior to redrive.

content.query:
let AppPrefix = strcat("aca-ewaste-", "{Environment}", "-");
let Signals = union isfuzzy=true
    (ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | project TimeGenerated, App=tostring(ContainerAppName_s), Message=tostring(Log_s)),
    (ContainerAppConsoleLogs | project TimeGenerated, App=tostring(ContainerAppName), Message=tostring(Log))
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and App startswith AppPrefix
| extend j=parse_json(Message)
| where toint(j.telemetry_version)==1
| extend Observation=tostring(j.observation), Outcome=tostring(j.outcome), Code=tostring(j.code),
         Correlation=tostring(j.correlation_id), Batch=tostring(j.batch_id),
         Operation=tostring(j.operation), FailureStreak=toint(j.failure_streak), RetryCount=toint(j.retry_count);
Signals
| where Outcome in ("QUARANTINED", "REJECTED")
     or FailureStreak >= 3
     or Observation in ("matching_request_failed", "delivery_paused", "consumer_error")
| project TimeGenerated, App, Observation, Operation, Outcome, Code, Batch, Correlation, RetryCount, FailureStreak, RawLog=Message
| order by TimeGenerated desc

content.json:
### Kafka Ingestion, Partition Lag & Consumer Backoff (Partition Queue Depth and Ingestion Velocity)
Monitors consumer offset velocity and per-partition lag. Note: **Samples older than 90 seconds are marked as `Stale`**. Stale lag does NOT mean zero lag.

content.query:
let AppPrefix = strcat("aca-ewaste-", "{Environment}", "-");
let Signals = union isfuzzy=true
    (ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | project TimeGenerated, App=tostring(ContainerAppName_s), Message=tostring(Log_s)),
    (ContainerAppConsoleLogs | project TimeGenerated, App=tostring(ContainerAppName), Message=tostring(Log))
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and App startswith AppPrefix
| extend j=parse_json(Message)
| where toint(j.telemetry_version)==1
| extend Observation=tostring(j.observation), Outcome=tostring(j.outcome), Code=tostring(j.code);
Signals
| where Observation == "consumer_lag" and isnotnull(j.partition)
| extend ConsumerGroup=tostring(j.consumer_group), Topic=tostring(j.topic), Partition=toint(j.partition)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) by App,ConsumerGroup,Topic,Partition
| extend Stale=TimeGenerated < ago(90s), Available=tobool(j.sample_available)
| project App, ConsumerGroup, Topic, Partition, LastSample=TimeGenerated, Stale, Available,
          Lag=iif(Available and not(Stale), tolong(j.consumer_lag), long(null)),
          CommittedOffset=tolong(j.committed_offset), EndOffset=tolong(j.end_offset)
| order by App asc, Topic asc, Partition asc

content.json:
### End-to-End Distributed Request Trace (Correlated Ingress, Outbox Relay, and Matching Execution)
Traces all processing steps associated with a specific correlation ID across HTTP ingress, database outbox relay, Kafka consumer, and matching decisions.

content.query:
let AppPrefix = strcat("aca-ewaste-", "{Environment}", "-");
let SearchId = "{CorrelationId}";
let Signals = union isfuzzy=true
    (ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | project TimeGenerated, App=tostring(ContainerAppName_s), Message=tostring(Log_s)),
    (ContainerAppConsoleLogs | project TimeGenerated, App=tostring(ContainerAppName), Message=tostring(Log))
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and App startswith AppPrefix
| extend j=parse_json(Message)
| where toint(j.telemetry_version)==1
| extend Observation=tostring(j.observation), Outcome=tostring(j.outcome), Code=tostring(j.code),
         Correlation=tostring(j.correlation_id), Batch=tostring(j.batch_id),
         Operation=tostring(j.operation), DurationMs=todouble(j.duration_ms);
Signals
| where isempty(SearchId) or Correlation == SearchId or Batch == SearchId or Message has SearchId
| project TimeGenerated, App, Observation, Operation, Outcome, Code, Batch, Correlation,
          EventId=tostring(j.event_id), CommandId=tostring(j.command_id), DurationMs
| order by TimeGenerated asc

### Release Evidence, SBOMs & Governance Verification Links
**Task:** Promote only signed digests and retain SBOMs | **Governance Standard:** Release Security Gate Policy

Every container deployed to Azure Container Apps is verified against immutable `@sha256:` digests and anchored to audited supply-chain release evidence retained for 90 days.

| Verification Artifact | Description | Repository & Run Reference |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Backend API SBOM** | 60 Go static packages (SPDX 2.3 JSON) | [sbom-workflow-api.spdx.json](https://github.com/nus-iss-dmss-practice-module-team5/team5-ewaste-platform/blob/dev/releases/sboms/sbom-workflow-api.spdx.json) |
| **Frontend UI SBOM** | 18 npm packages (SPDX 2.3 JSON) | [sbom-workflow-ui.spdx.json](https://github.com/nus-iss-dmss-practice-module-team5/team5-ewaste-platform/blob/dev/releases/sboms/sbom-workflow-ui.spdx.json) |
| **Analytics Worker SBOM** | 7 Python packages (SPDX 2.3 JSON) | [sbom-workflow-analytics.spdx.json](https://github.com/nus-iss-dmss-practice-module-team5/team5-ewaste-platform/blob/dev/releases/sboms/sbom-workflow-analytics.spdx.json) |
| **Cosign Root Public Key** | Team ECDSA P-256 Signature Verification Key | [security/cosign.pub](https://github.com/nus-iss-dmss-practice-module-team5/team5-ewaste-platform/blob/dev/security/cosign.pub) |
| **CI/CD Evidence Pipeline** | GitHub Actions 90-day Artifact Store | [CD Deployment Runs](https://github.com/nus-iss-dmss-practice-module-team5/team5-ewaste-platform/actions/workflows/cd-pipeline.yml) |
| **Release Catalog & Runbook** | Multi-environment promotion runbook | [releases/sboms/README.md](https://github.com/nus-iss-dmss-practice-module-team5/team5-ewaste-platform/blob/dev/releases/sboms/README.md) |

---

#### Runtime Digest Verification Check (Gate 3 Release Verification and Refusal Tests)
All Azure Container Apps are deployed strictly using immutable digest locators. To verify the live revision digests from Azure CLI:
```bash
az containerapp show --name aca-ewaste-{Environment}-api --resource-group rg-ewaste-{Environment} --query "properties.template.containers[0].image"
az containerapp show --name aca-ewaste-{Environment}-analytics --resource-group rg-ewaste-{Environment} --query "properties.template.containers[0].image"
az containerapp show --name aca-ewaste-{Environment}-ui --resource-group rg-ewaste-{Environment} --query "properties.template.containers[0].image"
```
